368185.custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin (on the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button; you appear as Admin ShopView). Everything below is at the same location, called {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • A desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  • A customer used by this case only, called {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST Customer Tab Count"), with one contact and two assets: {Asset-A} (for example unit TRK-201) and {Asset-B} (for example unit TRK-202).
  • Three work orders for {Asset-A}: {Work-order-A} at Estimate with one line; {Work-order-B} at Approved with two lines, of which only the first, {Line-A}, is completed ({Line-B} stays open); {Work-order-C} at Complete.
  • One work order for {Asset-B}, called {Work-order-D}, at Approved.
  • All four work orders are made at {Location-A} (the customer's tabs list only the chosen location's work orders).
368185.custom_steps:
1. Click Customers in the top menu.
  2. Open {Customer-A}.
  3. Click its Work Orders tab (the tab label shows the count, for example "Work Orders (4)").
  4. Look at the count shown for the list (on the tab label or under the table, for example "1-3 of 3").
  5. Count the rows in the table.
368185.expected_head:
Expected results

  • Steps 4 and 5: The count reads 4 and the table has 4 rows. The two numbers are the same.
368185.moved: Setup block (8 steps) -> doc Part 1 steps 1-25 and Part 2 setup calls; Needs/Build lines removed (window width kept); [WO-A..D] -> {Work-order-A..D}, customer/assets -> {Customer-A}/{Asset-A}/{Asset-B}; step 1 split into steps 1-3, expected line now "Steps 4 and 5".

368188.custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin (on the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button; you appear as Admin ShopView). Everything below is at the same location, called {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • A desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Two technicians at {Location-A}, each with Role Technician, a Department and Time Clock on: {Technician-A} (for example "Ana Alpha"; use exactly this name, the expected results name it) and {Technician-B} (for example "Ben Bravo"; use exactly this name).
  • A customer used by this case only, called {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST Asset Tab Toggle Lead"), with one contact and one asset, {Asset-A} (for example unit TRK-201).
  • One Approved work order for {Asset-A}, called {Work-order-A} (for example S1-760), with Lead Technician {Technician-A}.
368188.custom_steps:
1. Click Customers in the top menu.
  2. Open {Customer-A}.
  3. Click its Assets tab.
  4. Click the {Asset-A} row.
  5. Click its Work Orders tab.
  6. In the {Work-order-A} row click the Asset on Site toggle (the location pin in the On Site column).
  7. Reload the page.
  8. Look at the Asset on Site value (green pin = on site, faded red = not).
  9. Open {Work-order-A}.
  10. Look at Lead Technician.
368188.expected_head:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the toggle flips with no error message.
  • Step 8: the new Asset on Site value is kept.
  • Step 10: Lead Technician still reads {Technician-A} ("Ana Alpha").

368188.notes: Expected line 3 keeps the source-named value "Ana Alpha" beside {Technician-A}.

368189.custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin (on the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button; you appear as Admin ShopView). Everything below is at the same location, called {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • A desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Two tabs of the same browser window, tab 1 and tab 2, both signed in as Admin ShopView.
  • Two technicians at {Location-A}, each with Role Technician, a Department and Time Clock on: {Technician-A} (for example "Ana Alpha"; use exactly this name, the expected results name it) and {Technician-B} (for example "Ben Bravo"; use exactly this name, the expected results name it).
  • A customer used by this case only, called {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST Asset Tab Old Page"), with one contact and one asset, {Asset-A} (for example unit TRK-201).
  • One Approved work order for {Asset-A}, called {Work-order-A} (for example S1-762), with Lead Technician {Technician-A}.
368189.custom_steps:
1. In tab 1, click Customers in the top menu.
  2. In tab 1, open {Customer-A}.
  3. Click its Assets tab.
  4. Click the {Asset-A} row.
  5. Click its Work Orders tab and leave tab 1 open on it.
  6. In tab 2, open {Work-order-A}.
  7. In tab 2, change Lead Technician to {Technician-B}.
  8. Do not reload tab 1.
  9. In tab 1, click the {Work-order-A} row's Asset on Site toggle (location pin).
  10. In tab 1, open {Work-order-A}.
  11. Look at Lead Technician.
  12. Look at Asset on Site for {Work-order-A} (on the asset page row: green pin = on site).
368189.expected_head:
Expected results

  • Step 11: Lead Technician reads {Technician-B} ("Ben Bravo"). The older page in browser 1 did not put {Technician-A} (Ana Alpha) back.
  • Step 12: The Asset on Site change from step 9 is kept.
368189.moved: Setup block (6 steps) -> doc Part 1 steps 1-15 and Part 2 setup calls; Needs line (2 tabs) removed, two-tab need kept as its own bullet; [WO-1] -> {Work-order-A}, technicians -> {Technician-A}/{Technician-B}; old 4 steps split into 12 (old 3 -> 8 "do not reload" + 9, old 4 -> 10-12); expected lines given Step 11/12 and "step 3" reference updated to "step 9".
368189.notes: Expected keeps "browser 1" wording (meaning tab 1) unchanged; source-named values kept beside the brace names.
